lead.event: ADNOC CEO says global energy buffer stocks are depleted
lead.headline: ADNOC CEO says global energy buffers are depleted as oil stocks fall nearly 1 billion barrels
lead.blurb: Sultan Al Jaber said at ADIPEC in the UAE on 2 November that global oil inventories had fallen nearly 1 billion barrels since war-related disruption to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz began. Diesel stocks in several regions are at their lowest in 35 years for this period, while LNG shortages in some markets reach 600 billion cubic feet and logistics costs have risen to 30% of the cost per barrel from about 5%. The IEA has agreed to release more than 20 million barrels of diesel, as Brent trades around US$110 per barrel, roughly 50% above February.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BIC secures US$1.58 billion in financing for a Batam coal-fired power plant
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BIC secures US$1.58 billion for Batam coal-fired power plant
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The package comprises a US$900 million loan arranged by BCA, BTN and BRI and guaranteed by Gallant Venture, plus a convertible bond of up to US$683.6 million from Broadwood Holding. The bond matures in four years and converts into BIC shares at a 31.88% discount to post-dilution equity valuation on specified events, including a listing or Gallant Venture's sale of BIC shares.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Mandiri issues US$750 million perpetual bond
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BMRI issues US$750 million perpetual bond
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Mandiri set an initial annual distribution rate of 7.35% through bookbuilding with international investors. The bond will strengthen additional Tier 1 capital and has a first reset date of 10 September 2031.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Four Prajogo-affiliated issuers continue share buybacks
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TPIA, BRPT, BREN and CUAN continue buybacks, reaching Rp830.7 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Chandra Asri repurchased 378.43 million shares worth Rp518.2 billion through 2 November, the largest individual total. The four programs have combined maximum allocations of Rp4.5 trillion, with more than Rp3 trillion still available. TPIA’s program runs through 28 January 2027, while the other three run through 31 December 2026.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: MTEL reports a short-term debt surge and marginal nine-month profit growth
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MTEL short-term loans surge 450% as nine-month profit rises 0.77%
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Mitratel's short-term loans reached Rp2.2 trillion at 30 September, from Rp400 billion at end-2025, lifting total loans 5.3% to Rp20.1 trillion. Net profit was Rp1.55 trillion for January-September, while revenue rose 1.81% to Rp7.01 trillion.

market_structure_policy.event: MSCI warns Indonesia after market-manipulation allegations; regulators respond
market_structure_policy.headline: MSCI warns Indonesia could be downgraded by up to two tiers
market_structure_policy.blurb: The warning follows concerns over share-ownership transparency and coordinated trading, including alleged schemes to boost prices and volumes for index inclusion. Regulators fined several companies and securities firms, while MSCI removed Barito Renewables, Petrindo and Chandra Asri from its index.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX will delist 18 issuers on November 10, 2026
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX will delist 18 issuers on 10 November
market_structure_policy.blurb: Sri Rejeki Isman (SRIL) is among the seven companies declared bankrupt and scheduled for delisting. The other 11 had been suspended for more than 50 months, and all 18 must meet listed-company obligations until delisting takes effect on 10 November.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: PT Sri Rejeki Isman (SRIL) is among the seven bankrupt companies scheduled for delisting.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK sanctions PCAM and Aurora Asset Management
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK revokes Pratama Capital’s license and orders liquidation of 15 funds
market_structure_policy.blurb: The revocation took effect on 14 October, with the appointed custodian bank tasked with liquidating the funds. OJK also barred President Director Iwan Margana from financial-sector leadership for five years and directors Alfa Sri Aditya and Janto Supandi for two years.

earnings_guidance.event: Indofood reports nine-month earnings as ICBP raises FY26 sales guidance
earnings_guidance.headline: INDF and ICBP report 9M earnings as ICBP raises FY26 sales guidance to 12–14%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Indofood CBP said 9M26 sales grew 15%, above its original 5–7% target, while maintaining its FY26 EBIT margin target of 20–22%. Sales reached Rp64.45 trillion, but net profit attributable to owners fell 13.25% to Rp6.16 trillion.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: ICBP raised its FY26 sales growth guidance to 12–14%.

earnings_guidance.event: VRNA swings to a Q3 net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: VRNA swings to Q3 net profit of Rp2.48 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mizuho Leasing Indonesia's revenue fell 3.51% year on year to Rp320.9 billion. The turnaround was driven by a 5.16% decline in expenses to Rp315.66 billion, including an 8.34% drop in interest and finance costs to Rp92.40 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Fortune Resources Investment reports nine-month revenue and profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: FITT reports 622% Q3 revenue growth as profit turns to Rp29.41 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mining services contributed Rp41.26 billion, a revenue segment absent a year earlier. Total assets rose 75% to Rp224.75 billion, while hotel and banquet revenue fell to Rp2.70 billion and Rp1.08 billion, respectively.

earnings_guidance.event: Telkom Indonesia reports Q3 2026 revenue growth
earnings_guidance.headline: TLKM reports Q3 revenue growth of 3.5% to Rp113.5 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Telkom Indonesia’s Data, Internet & IT Services revenue rose 8.3% year on year to Rp71.5 trillion. EBITDA reached Rp55.5 trillion at a 48.9% margin, while normalized net profit increased 3.9% to Rp16.5 trillion.

deals_control.event: Bumi Resources delays acquisition of Laman Mining stake
deals_control.headline: BUMI extends deadline for 45% Laman Mining stake acquisition to 31 January 2027
deals_control.blurb: BUMI and Supreme Global Investment extended the deadline from early October 2026, with several acquisition prerequisites still unmet. The US$59.1 million purchase includes a US$20 million down payment, with US$39.1 million due after the conditions are met; BUMI has prepared around Rp333.6 billion for the final transaction.

deals_control.event: Karya Energy reports a sharp nine-month net profit decline
deals_control.headline: IATA reports 86.61% nine-month net profit decline
deals_control.blurb: Karya Energy's revenue was nearly flat at USD55.36 million, while direct expenses rose to USD33.65 million and gross profit fell to USD21.71 million. Controlling shareholder Karya Pacific bought 663.23 million shares at Rp87 each for about Rp57.7 billion, lifting its stake to 62.47% from 60.35%; the purchase was completed on 19 October.
